items.title: World’s top court to rule if Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
items.summary: International court of justice has never before found a state guilty of genocide, and ruling will have implications for case against Israel The world’s top court will deliver a judgment this week on whether Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya…
